atAGlance: Cà phê sữa nóng is hot phin coffee over condensed milk, sweet, fragrant, and stronger than its creamy look suggests.
whatItIs: Cà phê sữa nóng is phin coffee dripping onto condensed milk, served hot in a small glass or cup. Expect hot condensed-milk coffee: thick, sweet, fragrant, and stronger than the creamy look suggests.
howToEnjoy: Stir fully before sipping so the first taste is not just condensed milk at the bottom.
howLocalsOrder: Cà phê sữa nóng is for slow hot sipping, usually with condensed milk already in the cup. Ask less sweet before brewing if you want more coffee bitterness than caramel milk.
worthKnowing: In Vietnam, Cà phê sữa nóng turns the phin drip into a slow, warming ritual, especially at morning cafés and sidewalk tables.
goodToKnow: Sweetness is built in; ask for less milk if the café can adjust it.
